labs.title: Aggregate with Streams + Collectors
labs.goal: Group records and sum a field with the Stream API — the go-to way to do in-memory reporting/analytics in modern Java.
steps: Model an Order as a record (region, amount).
Group by region and sum amounts with Collectors.groupingBy + summingInt.
Use a TreeMap supplier for deterministic, sorted output.

labs.title: Async compose with CompletableFuture
labs.goal: Combine two async computations and transform the result without blocking — the standard non-reactive way to orchestrate concurrent work.
steps: get() the final result and print it.

labs.title: Thread-safe memoization cache
labs.goal: Cache expensive results with ConcurrentHashMap.computeIfAbsent — a lock-free pattern for safe, compute-once caching under concurrency.
steps: Use computeIfAbsent so the value is computed at most once per key.
Count how many times the compute lambda actually runs.
Prove repeated lookups reuse the cached value.

labs.title: Fan-out with virtual threads
labs.goal: Fetch three URLs concurrently using a virtual-thread executor and join results without a reactive stack.
steps: Submit three Callable tasks that return a String (simulate with Thread.sleep + return).
Collect results with Future.get() and print them joined by commas.
Compare mentally: how would this look with CompletableFuture.allOf?
